title: Signed Magnitude Selector
statement: Design a datapath selector that compares two 8-bit signed operands and outputs the one with larger signed magnitude when a control input is set. It should also output a flag indicating if the selected operand was negative. This shows magnitude-based decision logic in datapaths.
module_signature: module signed_magnitude_selector(input signed [7:0] a, input signed [7:0] b, input sel, output reg signed [7:0] y, output reg negative);
behavior: If sel is 0, select the larger signed operand by value.
If sel is 1, select the operand with larger absolute magnitude.
negative indicates if y is negative.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not infer sequential state; output may be reg for combinational assignment.
hint: Implement both signed comparison and absolute-value magnitude comparison.
